Name: Pinzon Murdoch Rubberwood and Glass Dining Table

Durable, versatile, expertly crafted dining table features a round design and plenty of leg room Solid rubberwood with dark brown Cosmo finish; tempered glass top with beveled edge Holds up to 100 pounds; arrives ready to assemble Coordinates with the Pinzon Murdoch Dining Collection Measures 50 inches in diameter by 30-1/4 inches high
